exposure: presentation of the second twin (breech, transverse lie, vertex)
outcome: indications for cesarean delivery of second twins
fetal outcomes of the second twin
cohort: 441 twin pregnancies with vaginal delivery of the first twin
finding: Transverse lie of the second twin is strongly associated with combined delivery, suggesting that attempts at vaginal delivery in vertex/transverse twin pregnancies may not be worthwhile.
mod_finding: Second twins delivered by combined delivery had a higher incidence of 5-minute Apgar score < 7.
